note: Facts as stated on each source page on the checked date. Fees change; always confirm on the source.

rows.name: BitPay
rows.fees: 2% + 25¢ (under $500K/mo), 1.5% + 25¢ ($500K–$999,999/mo), 1% + 25¢ ($1M+/mo); higher for high-risk industries
rows.notes: Settle in local currency, crypto, or a mix. Also lists other coins and tokens.

rows.name: Coinbase Business (payments)
rows.fees: Not published (Coinbase says current fees are shown inside the account)
rows.notes: Available in the US and Singapore per Coinbase. USDC→USD auto-conversion carries a fee.

rows.name: Stripe – Stablecoin payments
rows.fees: 1.5% of the transaction amount (Stripe pricing page; the page also shows a 0.8% promotional rate through Jan 1, 2027 in one section)
rows.notes: Accepts USDC on Tempo, Ethereum, Solana, Polygon and Base; USDP and USDG (US-only). Presented in USD.

rows.name: PayPal – PayPal USD (PYUSD)
rows.fees: No fee to convert USD↔PYUSD 1:1 on PayPal (per PayPal); other fees not published
rows.notes: PYUSD can be spent at U.S. merchants where PayPal is accepted, per PayPal.

rows.name: NOWPayments
rows.fees: 1% service fee (as listed on pricing page); network fees separate
rows.notes: Supported list includes XLM, XDC, HBAR, and Zebec (ZBC on Solana), plus USDC/USDT/PYUSD.

rows.name: CoinGate
rows.fees: 1% payment processing (Standard plan); crypto payouts 0.50 EUR + 0.5%
rows.notes: USDC on Ethereum, BSC, Solana, Polygon, Arbitrum, Base, Optimism; XRP on XRP Ledger.

rows.name: CryptAPI
rows.fees: 1% at low volume, down to 0.25% by 30-day volume; plus network fees
rows.notes: Payment API. CryptAPI's homepage notes USDT support on TON.

rows.name: Triple-A
rows.fees: Not published (negotiated per merchant, per Triple-A terms)
rows.notes: USDT (Ethereum, Tron, Polygon, Arbitrum, Solana), USDC (Ethereum, Polygon, Arbitrum, Solana), PYUSD (Ethereum).

rows.name: Ripple Payments
rows.fees: Not published
rows.notes: For banks, fintechs, and businesses. Ripple cites 60+ markets; XRP can be used as a bridge asset and RLUSD for settlement.

rows.name: Circle Payments Network (CPN)
rows.fees: Not published
rows.notes: Network of banks, PSPs and fintechs settling in USDC (and EURC). Circle cites 25+ blockchains supported.

rows.name: MoneyGram Ramps
rows.fees: Not published
rows.notes: Cash in/out of USDC on Stellar at MoneyGram locations; Stellar cites 170+ countries with USDC cash-out.

rows.name: BVNK
rows.fees: Not published
rows.notes: Added Stellar to its stablecoin payments platform on Sep 22, 2026.

rows.name: Bridge (a Stripe company)
rows.fees: Not published
rows.notes: APIs to accept USD, USDC, USDT and settle in stablecoins; also issuance APIs.

rows.name: XDC Payments (with Bridge)
rows.fees: Not published
rows.notes: XDC Foundation reported the XDC Payments platform live with Bridge for fiat on/off-ramps, virtual accounts and payouts (week of Jul 12–18, 2026).

rows.name: MoonPay
rows.fees: Not published on the page checked
rows.notes: Consumer on-ramp; lists USDC, USDT and XRP among supported assets.

rows.name: Transak
rows.fees: Not published on the page checked
rows.notes: Coverage list includes RLUSD (Ethereum and XRPL), XLM, HBAR and XRP.

rows.name: Visa – stablecoin settlement
rows.fees: Not published
rows.notes: Pilot for issuers and acquirers. Apr 29, 2026: added five chains, alongside existing Avalanche, Ethereum, Solana and Stellar.

rows.name: Metal Pay
rows.fees: Not published
rows.notes: App transfers settle on XPR Network, per Metal Pay.

rows.name: Zebec Payroll
rows.fees: Not published
rows.notes: Stablecoin payroll; MoneyGram Ramps added as fiat off-ramp on Stellar (Sep 2026).

rows.name: Zebec Cards
rows.fees: Silver: single load, no fees; Carbon: no transaction fees (per Zebec). Other fees not published
rows.notes: Virtual cards powered by Mastercard, per Zebec.

rows.name: XPayr – HBAR checkout
rows.fees: Flat 0.5% gateway fee (per XPayr)
rows.notes: Non-custodial HBAR checkout.

rows.name: AlgoVoi – Hedera
rows.fees: Not published on the page checked
rows.notes: Hosted checkout for HBAR and USDC (HTS token) on Hedera.

rows.name: Wholly Crypto – Hedera
rows.fees: Default 1% of invoice fiat value (per Wholly Crypto); network fees separate
rows.notes: Native HBAR only; HTS tokens not accepted.
